compose = """services:
  web:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      - db
      - cache
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@db:5432/app

  db:
    image: postgres:16
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=pass

  cache:
    image: redis:7

volumes:
  pgdata:
"""

def count_services(text):
    in_services = False
    count = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.strip() or line.strip().startswith("#"):
            continue
        indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip())
        if indent == 0:
            in_services = line.strip() == "services:"
            continue
        if in_services and indent == 2 and line.strip().endswith(":"):
            count += 1
    return count

n = count_services(compose)
assert n == 3
assert "postgres:16" in compose and "redis:7" in compose
assert "8000:8000" in compose and "pgdata:" in compose
print(f"Valid docker-compose.yml with {n} services")
